title: The Beauty of Theatrics
subtitle: This is the end of one drama and the beginning of another.

items.text: The Beauty of Theatrics
The cavalry left the town, dejected and broken.
As the gates closed, the bells chimed once more.
But this time, its toll was slow and drawn out.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: They're gone...?
Charlie staggered back as if drained of all her strength.
She gasped violently, filling her lungs with air.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: T-they...really left?!
As she tried to compose herself, the people around her and the burning buildings lining the streets began to sway.
Finally, the whole scene shattered like a popped bubble, revealing the true appearance of the street.
The festive bonfire continued to blaze in the square, its flames turning the surroundings as bright as day.
But only a small portion of the crowd had vanished; more people remained behind her.
Yes, it wasn't an illusion, but rather they had been all, or almost all, too real.
After a few moments of silence, a cheer erupted from the crowd.

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: We did it! I can't believe it, we actually drove them away!

items.speaker: Vendor
items.text: Hurrah!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: A flawless performance, Troupe Master Charlie! A flawless performance!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: A haunting performance of unprecedented magnitude!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: L—Let's not talk about it anymore!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Oh... I... I was so scared. Just thinking about what happened... I can't stop shaking!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: You... You did it! You really scared off the Duke's men!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: No... I didn't do anything at all! I might have put everyone at risk!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: If it weren't for all of you ... my poor tricks would've been exposed ...

items.speaker: Old Man
items.text: There's no need to be modest. You gave us the courage to resist. We came together because of your call.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: This is an outright victory, Troupe Master Charlie.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: You gave them a taste of their own medicine and taught them a lesson for all of us.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: R-Really...?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Mr. Jeffrey was right. These knights will never reveal what happened today.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: The tyrant's lackeys rely on lies and fear to maintain power, fearing people might discover how weak he truly is...

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Their actions are driven by self-interest. They won't speak of this; it would never serve their purpose.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: That's amazing! We really did it!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But, Troupe Master Charlie, I must remind you of something.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Though emotions will run high for now, please don't forget there's another act still to come.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Something greater still...

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Our earlier performance was but a dress rehearsal. What's comes next is the real show, the most crucial of our performances.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: The eager crowd has already gathered; step onto the stage and answer their call.
With the bells tolling, their audience converged on the square from all directions.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Their faces filled with anticipation for a performance befitting the festival.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: ...Yes, yes! You're right, Mr. Fool! Now begins the most important part of the show!
She took a deep breath, her expression turning serious.
It was the same look she always wore when she stepped onto the stage.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Let's get started, Mr. Fool.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: May we echo the promise we made to our audience and let them know that the theater we cherish won't end here.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Because the joy of theater can have a lasting impact.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: It can overcome hardship, defeat fear, and even conquer the greed of Minos.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Yes, even if it's an illusion, what people experience is far from some meaningless bubble.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: That is where our little story ends. I wonder, Miss Vertin, was the story to your satisfaction?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: You see, that is the true meaning of theater.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Whether real or illusory, people will find in the performance an inspiration to resonate with.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Were you wondering about which play the troupe is performing?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: If you ask me, it's still a little too early for Christmas.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: But for a story like this, ending it with a little comedy seemed quite fitting.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: I'm curious... What do you think?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Oh, there's no need to answer. I believe deep down inside, you already know.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: —But all this remaining the same, I hope you enjoyed the story.
THE END
